components.css: .ds-card-model { display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; box-shadow: 1px 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 1rem; background: #ffffff; overflow: hidden; color: rgb(15 23 42); text-decoration: none; } .ds-card-model:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 2px 5px 12px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 2px 2px 6px 0 rgb(0 97 101 / 40%); color: rgb(0, 97, 101); } .ds-card-model-media { position: relative; height: 160px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(100,116,139,0.8) 0%, rgba(15,23,42,0.8) 100%); } .ds-card-model-fallback span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-size: 3rem; } .ds-card-model-badge { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; border-top-right-radius: 12px; background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); padding: 2px 8px; max-width: 85%; color: #fff; font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-model-label { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Apparatus Filter Toggle
components.description: One selectable part of the interactive photosynthesis apparatus scheme — greyscale/dimmed by default, full illustration color when its matching tag is active. Illustration colors are one-off per part, not design tokens.
components.html: <svg width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 120 120"><g class="ds-apparatus" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-pressed="false"><ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="40" ry="50" fill="#5fad56" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" /><text x="60" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">PSII</text></g></svg>
components.css: .ds-apparatus { filter: grayscale(1) opacity(0.5); transition: filter 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-apparatus:hover { filter: grayscale(0.5) opacity(0.85); } .ds-apparatus[aria-pressed="true"] { filter: none; } .ds-apparatus[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-apparatus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(0, 97, 101); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The Journal Figure (inherited from @computational-biology-aachen/design; see pkg-js/design/.impeccable/design.json for the full system)
narrative.overview: GreenSloth has no visual identity of its own — it consumes the CPBL Design System's tokens and Svelte components directly. This sidecar records only what's local to GreenSloth: two component extensions (CardModel, the apparatus filter toggle) and two semantic colors (sim-error, sim-warning) that the shared package doesn't define. Everything else — buttons, cards, inputs, nav, sections, charts — renders exactly as specified in the shared package's own DESIGN.md and sidecar.
keyCharacteristics: CardModel: 16px radius + lift-and-glow hover, versus the shared Card's 8px radius + scale(1.03).
The apparatus scheme is greyscale-until-selected — the one place illustration color, not brand color, carries meaning.
sim-error/sim-warning are GreenSloth-only semantic colors for simulation failure states, separate from the shared package's single danger color.

rules.name: The Greyscale-Until-Selected Rule
rules.body: Any diagram-based filter control defaults to desaturated/dimmed and restores full color only on selection.

rules.name: The Illustration-Is-Not-Chrome Rule
rules.body: The apparatus scheme's per-part fill colors are a biological-illustration palette, not design tokens, and must never be reused as UI chrome.

dos: Do use LineChart/LineChartGrid and the shared chart-series colors for every model plot.
Do keep CardModel scoped to the model gallery grid only.
Do default any new diagram-based filter control to greyscale, restoring color only on selection (The Greyscale-Until-Selected Rule).
donts: Don't promote the apparatus scheme's illustration colors to design tokens or UI chrome (The Illustration-Is-Not-Chrome Rule).
Don't fork another shared component without a documented, page-specific gap the way CardModel forks Card.
Don't add a third simulation-status color before checking sim-error/sim-warning.
